T01.name_zh: 精密刀刻 / 钢凹版视觉
T01.primary_zh: 以端点收细、宽窄受控的刀刻长线为主要结构；线群沿对象曲率与透视有规律地展开。
T01.primary_en: Dominant clean, tapered burin-cut strokes with controlled line-weight, arranged in curved bands aligned to surfaces and perspective.
T01.tone_zh: 明暗由线距、刻线粗细、成束方向与留白转换；交叉线仅点到为止，保持轮廓干净。
T01.tone_en: Modulate tone with spacing, line width, directional bands and untouched paper; cross-hatching remains minimal.
T01.edge_zh: 轮廓刀锋般清晰，转折处用刻线终止与疏密变化；避免机械等距网屏。
T01.edge_en: Crisp cutting edges, with line terminations and spacing changes at form boundaries; never a mechanical screen.
T01.avoid_zh: 禁止将整片天空、雾气铺满同向刻线；不要把点阵、模糊毛边或大面积连续黑调子作为主表现。
T01.avoid_en: Never blanket sky or mist with a single direction of hatching. Do not replace the main technique with dotted fields, fuzzy edges or seamless black tonal blankets.
T01.regional_zh: 长线只沿田埂曲率、坡面和建筑结构展开；远山线宽与密度递减；天空、雾气和高光不铺满长线。
T01.regional_en: Use long cuts only along terrace contours, slopes and structures; reduce line weight and density in distant mountains; leave sky, mist and highlights largely unmarked.

T02.primary_zh: 由笔触感明确、轻微不等距的蚀刻线组织形体；转折、材质和受力决定刻线组方向。
T02.primary_en: Dominant slightly irregular etched drawn lines, grouped by contour, material and local tension rather than a rigid grid.
T02.tone_zh: 用交叉排线的层数、角度变化和局部断线建调子，交叉只集中于实际需要的暗部；雾、天空及关键高光保留开放纸白。
T02.tone_en: Build values through intersecting hatch layers, direction changes and broken lines only where local shadows require them; leave mist, sky and key highlights open rather than hatching the entire scene.
T02.edge_zh: 边缘有手工绘线的活性，不是齐刷刷的刀口和不间断同向条纹。
T02.edge_en: Edges have lively drawn-line character rather than uniform, continuous, machine-parallel strokes.
T02.avoid_zh: 不要以无方向的均匀点刻或平滑暗调代替蚀刻线。
T02.avoid_en: Avoid replacing etched linear construction with uniform dots or smoothly blended dark masses.
T02.regional_zh: 交叉蚀线仅用于田埂背光面、木屋阴影和确有需要的植被暗部；远山使用稀疏短线，天空与雾气保留开放层次。
T02.regional_en: Restrict cross-etching to shadowed terrace faces, hut shadows and vegetation that needs it; use sparse short marks in distant mountains and keep sky and mist open.

T03.primary_zh: 以有压强轻重差异的短中程划痕刻线为主体，线缘带轻微储墨毛刺和绒感。
T03.primary_en: Dominant pressure-variable short-to-medium scratched lines with restrained ink-burr softness along the marks.
T03.tone_zh: 通过断续线簇与沿刻痕边缘出现的局部储墨毛刺构建体积；即使深影仍见刻痕方向，明部打开纸白，不得让全图同样柔糊。
T03.tone_en: Build form from broken scratched stroke clusters and localized ink burr attached to individual scratches; preserve mark direction in shadows and bare-paper highlights without blurring the whole scene.
T03.edge_zh: 接触边缘略带自然柔化，但主体身份和形体边界必须可靠。
T03.edge_en: Slightly feathered inked edges, but subject silhouette and defining geometry stay accurate.
T03.avoid_zh: 不要工业式等距排线、规则点阵或整图磨砂噪点。
T03.avoid_en: No industrial equally spaced hatching, regular dot screens, or all-over gritty noise.
T03.regional_zh: 短刻痕与储墨毛刺局限于田埂土壁、木材和植被边缘；毛刺必须贴附具体划痕，天空、雾气和远景不加全局磨砂。
T03.regional_en: Confine short scratches and ink burr to terrace soil, wood and vegetation edges; burr must cling to individual scratches, with no global grit in sky, mist or distance.

T04.primary_zh: 以彼此分离的、疏密与大小受控的雕刻墨点作为主体调子；轮廓只允许极少量清晰辅助线。
T04.primary_en: Dominant separated engraved dots of controlled density and size; permit only sparse precise outlines as support.
T04.tone_zh: 明暗主要靠局部点密与点径阶梯塑形，沿形体变化而非随机散点；纸白亮区点量极少。
T04.tone_en: Model values primarily with graded local dot frequency and size that follow form, not random speckle; bright paper zones stay nearly dot-free.
T04.edge_zh: 柔顺的点群过渡配合精准外轮廓，小图识别性不能丢失。
T04.edge_en: Smooth dotted transitions with faithful silhouettes; recognizable at thumbnail scale.
T04.avoid_zh: 禁止连续平行排线、明显交叉排线、连续喷绘渐变或在天空与雾气中无差别铺满点阵作为主要阴影。
T04.avoid_en: No continuous hatching, airbrush gradients or uniform dot screens over sky and mist as the main shading mechanism.
T04.regional_zh: 点密度随局部明暗变化；植被与土壁可较密，远山稀疏，天空和雾气仅极少点或无点，禁止均匀点幕。
T04.regional_en: Vary dot density with local value; allow denser dots in vegetation and soil, sparse dots in distant mountains, and almost none in sky or mist; never use a uniform dot screen.

T05.primary_zh: 以极细密摇刀颗粒形成的均匀深墨基调为主体，明亮区域通过刮削与磨光从暗底中显现。
T05.primary_en: Dominant velvet-rich tonal plate texture, as if prepared by mezzotint rocking; reveal lights through selective scraping and burnishing.
T05.tone_zh: 用连续但具有版画颗粒感的黑—灰—纸白明度塑造体积，而不是用长排线覆盖照片。
T05.tone_en: Model values through rich, print-grained continuous dark-to-light tonality rather than long hatch lines over a photograph.
T05.edge_zh: 暗部沉厚、亮部柔顺，焦点的形体轮廓仍清晰；不把整幅暗化。
T05.edge_en: Deep shadows and soft luminous regions with legible focal contours; do not blacken the entire scene.
T05.avoid_zh: 不得把大量交叉排线、点阵筛网、全局柔焦、数码高斯模糊或简单压暗照片伪装为美柔汀；需要真实可辨的局部绒黑调子与刮亮关系。
T05.avoid_en: Do not substitute cross-hatching, a dot screen, global soft-focus, Gaussian blur or simple darkening for mezzotint; require localized velvet plate tone and selectively revealed highlights.
T05.regional_zh: 绒黑只落在田埂背光面、木屋阴影和植被暗部；亮部以局部刮亮显现，远山随距离降低对比，天空与雾气保留原色和明度。
T05.regional_en: Keep velvet blacks local to shadowed terrace faces, hut shadows and dark vegetation; reveal highlights selectively, lower distant contrast, and preserve source colors and values in sky and mist.
